item.title: French Polynesia Cabin Cruise: The Floating Boutique Hotel for Effortless Island Hopping
item.description: Imagine waking up in a comfortable suite aboard a premium catamaran. You stretch out on crisp sheets and wonder what spectacular view is awaiting you today. Will it be the majestic twin peaks of Bora Bora or the white sand beaches and tropical jungles of Huahine? You step on deck and sniff the air: today’s port is actually the vanilla-scented shores of Taha’a. That’s what life is like aboard a French Polynesia cabin cruise. Every day, you get to go on a new adventure. At night, you rest and relax in the comfort of a spacious cabin aboard a shared catamaran charter. For many travelers, the freedom to visit multiple destinations rather than be confined to a single resort makes a cabin cruise a much better option than a typical holiday on land. What Is a French Polynesia Cabin Cruise? A French Polynesia catamaran cruise or cabin cruise is a travel option where you book a private cabin with its own attached bathroom on a catamaran. Instead of chartering an entire yacht yourself, you share the vessel with a small group of other travelers. How Cabin Cruises Work The catamaran operates much like a small-scale cruise ship but with a personalized touch. Your captain navigates the islands, and an onboard steward prepares your meals. This vacation style eliminates the stress of trip planning, sailing logistics, and meal preparation. And since vessels are shared among travelers, cabin cruises are more affordable than booking Tahiti yacht charters . Why It Feels Like a Floating Boutique Hotel Unlike massive cruise ships that carry thousands of passengers, a catamaran hosts between 8 and 12 guests. This creates an intimate atmosphere, similar to that of a small hotel, except you also get to experience different destinations and activities every day. In French Polynesia, our cabin cruises are offered on the Bali 5.4, Lagoon 620, and the Fountaine Pajot Ipanema 58, each accommodating 12 guests. Comfort and Convenience: What Is a Cabin Cruise Like Onboard? Life aboard a cabin charter is defined by relaxation and comfort. Your catamaran features decks, shaded outdoor dining areas, and a forward trampoline net. This net is a great spot to lounge as the islands glide by. No jostling for sunbathing space on crowded beaches or lining up to rent gear from stands along the shore. You can get all the sun you want on deck, and the cruise includes the use of water sports equipment. You can step directly off the yacht’s transom steps into the water, swim, snorkel, or kayak to your heart’s content. Island Hopping Without Repacking or Airport Transfers With 118 islands and atolls spread across an area as vast as Western Europe, French Polynesia island hopping is all about discovering the unique character of each destination. However, having your base camp be a hotel or resort limits your options. It also means you have to go through a drawn-out process of getting there before you can visit each different island. Traditional travelers must pack their suitcases, check out of their resorts, take a taxi to the airport, wait in security lines, and fly to the next island, only to repeat the check-in process. Meanwhile, on Tahiti cabin cruises , you unpack your bags once on arrival. While you relax on deck or sleep in your cabin, the catamaran moves you between Tahiti and other destinations like Huahine, Raiatea, Taha’a, and Bora Bora. A Tahiti cabin charter eliminates the need for regional flights and ferry schedules, saving you both travel stress and vacation time. Space, Food, Privacy, and Seasickness: Honest Answers Before booking a sailing trip, it is normal to have a few questions about how things work on a boat. Here is what daily life aboard your shared luxury catamaran looks like. Space: Yacht cabins are smaller than hotel rooms, but they’re just as well-appointed. item.title: The Bali 5.4 – perfect for crewed & cabin charters
item.description: With an impressive 54-foot length and 6 guest cabins, the Bali 5.4 makes an ideal charter vacation platform. Whether you choose a private fully crewed charter, or a social cabin charter, you’ll enjoy the comfort and efficient layout of this premium catamaran, while being looked after by your crew. Catamarans are popular for their generous liveable space and Bali has designed a beautiful and functional layout that optimizes space and comfort whether lounging and dining with a group or taking some quiet time in your private en suite cabin. It boasts an impressive 130 sq m of living space, so you’ll never feel cramped. Living areas for relaxing in comfort If you’re looking for a yacht that maximizes outdoor spaces while providing plenty of inviting and cozy interior areas, then the Bali 5.4 is for you. The pivoting rear door opens the entire back wall of the yacht to the outdoors, inviting natural light and sea breezes into the spacious salon. The salon is the central onboard gathering place where you can enjoy al fresco meals in the company of friends at the large dining table. To the front of the yacht, a door from the salon allows direct access to the massive front deck where you’ll find padded sunbeds, cushioned seating and a table. To the rear, the large transom deck provides a long bench seating area as well as steps on either side leading to the water for enjoying a swim or water sports. Your elevated chill lounge There are plenty of other outdoor spaces to enjoy aboard the Bali 5.4. Change your view onboard the Bali 5.4 with the spacious flybridge, accessible via a stairway on each side. The massive U-shaped cushioned seating area that surrounds the 2 dining tables is perfect for taking in the panoramic views while underway or enjoying an evening cocktail at anchor. A large sunbed to the rear of the seating area can easily accommodate a group of 3 to 4 guests for sunbathing and lounging. Whichever living space you choose, you’ll always have a place to relax and enjoy the view in comfort. Aboard the Bali 5.4, you will easily be able to spend a week or more while never feeling crowded. The clever layout, ample storage, multiple lounge areas, and attention to detail is perfectly designed for an unmatched sailing holiday. Take the tour Bali 5.4 cabins Our Bali 5.4 yachts each offer 6 guest cabins and can sleep up to 12 guests with queen-sized beds and plenty of storage space. Each guest cabin also features a private bathroom with shower, wash basin and toilet. Each comfortable cabin is equipped with air conditioning and windows for natural lighting. Some cabins feature a door with direct access to the deck. Our Bali 5.4 charter destinations The Bali 5.4 is available for crewed and cabin cruises, as well as bareboat and skippered charters, in many destinations throughout the world including the Mediterranean, Caribbean , Bahamas and Tahiti . About our charters Our fully crewed and cabin cruise staff are ready to make your dreams a reality with a sailing vacation that you’ll remember for years to come. Which sailing vacation type is right for you? Read more about our charter options , or contact a Dream Yacht Charter Planner for details. Share: Link Copied to Clipboard

item.title: Experience electric sailing in the Mediterranean
item.description: Now you can experience the joys of “silent sailing” from aboard our newest hybrid electric yachts in many of our stunning Mediterranean destinations. Our new electric yachts feature not only the latest in creature comforts and state of the art technology, but also deliver big on reducing carbon emissions – and notably for charterers – reducing the cost of fuel for your sailing vacation! Getting greener every day The new electric yachts based in the Mediterranean are a tangible realization of Dream Yacht’s commitment to sustainability and reducing ecological impact. More Fountaine Pajot and Dufour electric yachts are already underway, with ongoing significant fleet investments toward the ambition of an all-electric charter yacht offering and zero carbon emissions. Our Mediterranean hybrid electric yachts Choose from three outstanding new yachts – the impressive Fountaine Pajot Aura 51 Smart Electric and Elba 45 Smart Electric catamarans, or the sleek Dufour 530 Smart Electric sailing yacht. All are designed and manufactured to exacting standards of comfort and efficiency. A key difference in the electric boating experience includes cruising under power in silence, allowing you to more fully enjoy surrounding natural environments during your sailing vacation. The powerful, efficient and quiet electric motors are custom designed, with lithium technology battery banks for storing energy. When under sail, the speed of the boat along with the motors in reverse flow is used to produce clean, stored energy. This “hydroelectric” energy generation can recharge the batteries, which can then provide power for hours of silent motor cruising, or for enjoying time at anchor without noise from the generator. See where our hybrid electric yachts can take you! Discover the sophisticated French Riviera Dufour 530 Smart Electric yachts A Côte d’Azur yacht charter offers an unforgettable experience for those seeking to explore this stunning region. From aboard your Dufour 530 Smart Electric yacht, visit multiple destinations in one trip without the hassle of changing hotels or transportation. From our base location in Port Pin Rolland, sail to glamorous ports, beautiful beaches, and picturesque coastal towns. Discover the peaceful island paradise of Porquerolles, where cars are forbidden and the only way to get around is by bike, boat or on foot – perfect for slowing down and exploring the lovely village and harbor. Be sure to pick up a mooring in the Baie des Canebiers, where you can rub shoulders with the jet set in the old port of Saint-Tropez. This glamorous town is known for its picturesque harbor, upscale boutiques, and luxurious nightlife. Visit the Citadel de Saint-Tropez for panoramic views of the town and enjoy the famous beach clubs Sail in stunning Sardinia Dufour 530 monohull & Elba 45 catamaran Smart Electric yachts A yacht charter in Sardinia offers a unique and unforgettable experience for those looking to explore the stunning coastline and crystal-clear waters of this Mediterranean island. Sailing from our base location in Olbia, cruise the stunning Costa Smeralda discovering secluded coves, hidden beaches, and charming coastal towns that are only accessible by boat. An electric yacht can allow you to be silently immersed in this breathtaking natural beauty. For the jet set crowd, the luxurious resort town Porto Cervo will not disappoint with its upscale marina, designer boutiques, and exclusive clubs. And be sure to cruise the famed La Maddalena Archipelago, a stunning group of islands with pristine beaches, crystal-clear waters, and great snorkeling spots. Explore Naples & the Amalfi Coast by yacht Aura 51 Smart Electric yachts Board the impressive Aura 51 Smart Electric in Naples and discover the perfect blend of culture, history, and natural beauty.
